text: This Dental Clinic is part of Mission Phuket Hospital.  Dentists are professionals and they always tell you the price before you start. The Clinic has an administrative staff that informs you of appointments and always reminds you. The most important thing is that they have quality and modern medical equipment. I recommend this Clinic 100%. Enjoy Phuket!! Enjoy Thailand!!

Really good dentist department!
I got my wisdom tooth removed here; I also had an infection that made the surgery more complicated, but everything went great. Good prices, professional employees.
Can totally recommend!

I'm just back from having a rear lower-jaw molar removed at the Mission Hospital Dental Clinic.  It was painless and the dentist could not have been more professional and calming.  He talked me through everything and constantly asked if I was doing OK.  He told me what he was doing while he was doing it and updated me on the progress constantly.  As someone who is afraid of dentists, this was exactly what I needed!
I am not a fan of dentist's. However if you have the need for dental care. You will not find better care or more compassionate staff than those at Mission hospital.  Highly recommend 👌 …

Dr. Apichai is highly experienced and meticulous. He's one of the few on the island who understands implants and the intricacies of prosthetics.
